new: pravicāraṇā is taken as nominative plural (pravicāraṇāḥ, the visarga lost before the vowel of the next half-verse), agreeing with etāḥ. The sixty-four here (63 combinations with tastes + 1 plain) are a different count from the twenty-four of unit 25. bhavet is singular, so prayojyā is f. nom. sg. agreeing with catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ; pravicāraṇā may likewise be read as printed, f. nom. sg., with etāḥ plural by sense.
